name: ghostframe
description: The cockpit for Claude Code: a turn timeline, a docked pane with the turn's steps, files, sources, to-do and agents, and a two-row status line.

cockpit.title: Cockpit pane
cockpit.description: The Cockpit pane beside the transcript (timeline, files, sources, to-do, agents). On by default. GHOSTFRAME_COCKPIT=0 turns it off for one session, GHOSTFRAME_COCKPIT=1 on.

pastePreview.title: Paste previews
pastePreview.description: A long paste in your message shows its first lines and a count of the rest, instead of only [Pasted text #1 +N lines]. A paste that looks like it holds a key, token or password keeps the plain label. On by default.

statuslineIcons.title: Status line icons
statuslineIcons.description: Nerd Font icons in ghostframe's status line (branch, PR, cache). Off draws the same layout without them. The status line reads this on every update.
